edge_cases: p=0: identity rotation (cos=1, sin=0) -- out should equal x unchanged
p=1: pure 90-degree rotate (cos=0, sin=1) -- out[d]=-x[d2], out[d2]=x[d]
n_pairs=100 -> x has 200 fp16 elements, not a multiple of 64 fp16 lanes per HVX vector -- real tail/padding path
v68 has NO native Vhf arithmetic (vmpy.hf.hf/vadd.hf.hf/vsub.hf.hf all fail to lower) -- every vector op must go through the qf16 pipeline
sign-swapped near-miss must fail (broadly, and specifically at the cos=0,sin=1 edge pair)
name: rope_pair_fp16
